decisions_for_lead: Frames inside Groups: typed loss (text_frame_in_group_not_decoded, counted per nested frame) instead of decoding, because composing group transforms and re-nesting on export is a separate slice; the group is preserved verbatim by both write paths

First baseline: layout composes only a fixed first baseline measured from the frame top, InDesign defaults to AscentOffset, so every default IDML frame would be refused; reflow_import maps Ascent/Leading/Fixed to a fixed offset on a derived copy (inset_top + max(min offset, metric of the story's first shaped paragraph)) and reports it as first_baseline_mapped_to_fixed. UNVERIFIED against InDesign (whether the minimum offset is measured from the frame top or the inset edge, and whether the first line's metric differs per frame in a thread). Cap height / em box / x-height stay refused by layout

Shaping is a host port: IDML names fonts and carries none, Type needs font bytes, so ParagraphShaper is the seam (ShapeContext carries the story, text, paragraph index, byte source and IDML paragraph style name). FixedAdvanceShaper is a fixture, not shaping; no Type-backed shaper was written or exercised here

Folio export writes IDML ids deterministically and does not carry Folio ids in the file; style and language names come from ExportNames (IdmlImport::export_names() for imported documents); a Folio document created from scratch has no IDML style definitions, so style names reference styles the package does not define (InDesign behaviour for undefined style names UNVERIFIED)
export_folio validates with Folio before writing and refuses non-area stories (point/path/frame_grid) and unresolved stored content with typed errors rather than writing a partial package

Edited-import export regenerates designmap/spreads/stories from Folio (everything the decoder reported preserved_opaque in those parts, such as graphics and local overrides, is NOT carried because the Folio document does not hold it); lossless write-back into an existing IDML needs the Chronicle patch path (not built)
not_proven: No InDesign has opened a package written by export_folio/export_idml and no InDesign-produced fixture exists here; package shape, DOMVersion 16.0, PagesPerDocument=1 and container.xml layout follow the public structure and the Craft case study (behaviour reference only, no code copied) and are UNVERIFIED
Reflow correctness is proven only against layout's own conventions and hand-computed fixed-advance values; no Type shaping, no real fonts, no comparison with InDesign line breaks or its overset flag
Frames inside groups, anchored objects, text wrap, multiple columns, vertical justification, auto-sizing frames are not composed (refused or reported)
